items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: And we used to call him Uncle Don. Because he was there uncle.

ctx.x: And Don. The one I was telling you.
He didn't play a good piano. And we used to call him Uncle Don. Because he was there uncle. And all over his kids' car. Yeah, yeah. And sometimes when he'd come on dinner, he'd put dinner out to.
Yeah, we were at war or with that.
